request.input:
solo, 1man, mysterious middle-aged urban superhuman blocking a sealed laboratory loading entrance, charcoal hooded winter coat with asymmetrical desaturated teal lining, plain dark half-face respirator, muted red scarf, black gloves and practical trousers with heavy boots. Lean alert figure, left shoulder and head pointing screen-left, body in three-quarter left side view, one open hand lowered forward as if stopping an approaching opponent, other hand near waist. No firearm, no visible faction insignia, no scenery.

One complete full-body battle character illustration on a truly transparent background.

Body, face, gaze, feet and any forward-reaching limbs point toward SCREEN-LEFT. One complete centered figure with clean empty margins. Entire head, hands, feet and appendages inside canvas. Eye-level camera, no floor, no stage, no scenery. Full body, not a portrait crop.

Muted ivory, charcoal and restrained cool accents; readable broad shapes, dark cloth with grouped shadows, controlled warm skin and matte material transitions.

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
